CustomerProfile.title: CustomerProfile
CustomerProfile.description: Customer profile created via Google Sign-In or mobile registration at M Bee Enterprises, Mahilpur.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the customer.

memberId.description: Unique M Bee Enterprises client ID (e.g. MBE-G4821).

name.description: Full display name of the customer.

email.description: Google account email address of the customer.

city.description: City or village in Punjab (e.g., Mahilpur, Punjab).

authProvider.description: Authentication provider used to create the profile.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last profile update.

workHistory.description: Recent service cards clicked or work requests submitted by this customer.

submittedDocuments.description: Documents submitted by the customer to Admin with tracking status (Pending, Processing, Completed).

/users/{userId}.description: Stores private Google-linked customer profiles and their clicked service history for M Bee Enterprises.
